subject: Implement restart-resume contract via claude --resume session_id
description:
In `capo/workflows/delegation.py`, on workflow re-entry (after a process restart), the workflow's first step is to **re-spawn** the subagent via `claude --resume <session_id>` (per §7.5 resume invocation). **Never** re-attach by PID. On resume failure, mark the delegation `failed` with reason "session resume failed" and notify the user.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] On `monitor_delegation` re-entry, the first step re-spawns CC via `claude --resume <session_id> --output-format json [--model X]`.
- [ ] PID is updated on the row to the new subprocess PID; old PID is never reused.
- [ ] If `--resume` returns error, mark row `failed` with reason "session resume failed" and trigger `notify_user` step.
- [ ] Restart resilience: 100% of in-flight delegations resume after process restart (anchors §3.2 Phase 3 success metric).

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Restart mid-spawn (between subprocess.spawn and DB row insert): DBOS workflow doesn't exist yet; row is the source of truth — if missing, delegation is lost (acceptable per §5.6 edge case since user hasn't been told it started).
- [ ] Restart between completion and `notify_user`: idempotency key on `notify_user` prevents double-send.
- [ ] Session-resume fails: workflow marks `failed`, notifies user.
- [ ] Subprocess orphaned and reaped by macOS: resume via session_id succeeds regardless of PID state.

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] Failure path always notifies the user before terminating the workflow.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: kill -TERM Capo mid-CC-run, restart, verify new subprocess spawned via `--resume`
• Integration: simulated `--resume` failure → row `failed` + user notified
• Integration: success-metric test (anchors §3.2 row 1 + §9.3 checkpoint)

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 3.2, 5.6, 7.5, 9.3
